description: Trigger evals for code-context-map: it fires when an assistant needs a ranked structural overview of a codebase (files, imports, signatures, boundary calls) or an existing map is stale, while code-locate, impact-analysis, db-context-supabase, stack-recommend and workflow-guide handle finding one behavior, blast radius, a database schema, choosing a stack with no code yet, and onboarding someone to the workflow.

should_trigger: I just joined this repo and it has around 800 files. Build me a structural map I can hand to the assistant before we touch anything.
regenerate the code map for ~/work/billing-api, it's out of date since the refactor last week
Before editing the checkout flow, produce a token-budgeted overview of src/checkout and everything it imports, including the outbound http and queue calls.
give the agent a quick lay of the land for this monorepo, ranked by importance, gitignored output is fine
Starting from src/orders/service.ts, map the import chain with function signatures so grep has good seeds later.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Where in the codebase do we retry failed webhook deliveries? I just need the file and line range.
We plan to rename the Invoice status enum. What breaks across services, contracts and the schema if we do?
Pull the tables, columns and RLS policies for the profiles and teams tables from our hosted Supabase project so planning uses the real schema.
A new engineer starts on this repo Monday and has never used our task workflow. Walk them through where this task stands, which step comes next, and why.
There is no codebase yet for the new pricing service, so nothing to map. Research current stable versions and recommend the language, framework and database we should start on.
